purpose: Verified contract for citizen correction, supplementation and review of published property answers.
citizen_rights_in_scope: identify a missing source or route
governance_rules: Feedback is preserved separately from verified evidence.
New evidence enters the same identity, property-match, date-match and sufficiency controls as other evidence.
Material answer changes require quality-gate review.
Published snapshots are immutable; material corrections create a new snapshot linked to the predecessor.
Unresolved challenges remain visible as unresolved where material.
verification_boundary: This contract governs review workflow and citizen participation; it does not decide whether a citizen's correction is substantively correct.
public_boundary: Citizens should see the review outcome and material reason, not internal chain-of-thought, private metadata or restricted personal information.
